scope: Public source review for portfolio editorial accuracy; this does not certify the linked applications as production ready.

Provider operation polling is inside the HTTP request, not a durable worker queue.
The gallery preview uses a repository asset, not an authenticated dashboard capture.

Loan statuses are pending, approved and rejected.
No Next.js, Plaid, Appwrite, multi-bank aggregation or measured layout-shift claims.

SQLAlchemy source identity checks and repository persistence.
